qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507.mistake: There is no indication of a direct mistake in the mapping of FOL to NL for the pair in question. However, upon reviewing all pairs, the FOL statement ¬p_1(Elliott) is mapped to “Elliott cannot create masterpieces”. Here lies the mistake: ¬p_1(Elliott) means “Elliott does not create masterpieces”, which is not logically equivalent to “cannot”, as “cannot” implies inability (a modal or dispositional claim), whereas ¬p_1 expresses simple negation of the action or state. The natural language statement introduces a modal nuance (ability) not present in the FOL, which lacks modal operators. This is a mismatch in modality. All other mappings are reasonable under a charitable interpretation.
